Tamil Nadu Govt Denies Permission for Anti-NEET Campaign

The Tamil Nadu government denied permission to Kamal Haasan's Makkal Needhi Maiam (MNM) for an anti-National Entrance-cum-Eligibility Test (NEET) tour. The Left parties and other opposition groups have criticized the state government's decision. The MNM intended to conduct the tour to protest against the NEET examination.
